description: File a bug report about Muggle AI itself (the harness, a run, the dashboard, billing) for the Muggle team. Takes title, description, severity and optional steps / expected / actual, screenshotPaths read from this machine (images only, at most 5, 5 MB each) and clientContext from muggle-local-bug-report-context-get; secret-looking context values are dropped before sending. Not for a generated test script that did the wrong thing: that is muggle-remote-user-feedback-create. Returns the report with its bugReportId and shortId (e.g. BUG-4821) plus dashboardUrl to the ticket. Ten reports per hour per user.

clientContext.description: Context captured where the bug was hit; pass data.clientContext from muggle-local-bug-report-context-get

description.description: What happened, in the user's words

screenshotPaths.description: Absolute paths of up to 5 screenshots on this machine (png, jpg, gif or webp, at most 5 MB each). They are read from disk and uploaded with the report.

severity.description: The user's call: blocker (cannot continue), major (works around it with effort), minor (cosmetic or small)

stepsToReproduce.description: Steps that make the bug happen

name: muggle-remote-bug-report-create
